comment: QGroundControl custom action set for ArduRocket. Load it in QGC under Application Settings -> General -> Fly View -> Custom Action (Custom action JSON file). It adds a 'Fin Check' button to the Fly view so the operator can run the on-rail fin check with one tap, then ARM normally. This exists because these are FINS, not motors: without it the only built-in trigger is the mislabelled, buried Motor Test panel.

actions.label: Fin Check
actions.description: Run the fin wiggle on the rail. Watch each fin move the direction you expect, then ARM. On the rail this latches the arming gate; on the bench it just exercises the fins.
